title: Blest Be the Tie That Binds (Boylston)
description: Blest Be the Tie That Binds (Boylston) in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 6 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by John Fawcett, first published in 1782. The tune, BOYLSTON, is by Lowell Mason (1832). This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: Blest be the tie that binds Our hearts in Christ-ian love; The fel-low-ship of kin-dred minds Is like to that a-bove.

lines: Blest be the tie that binds
Our fears, our hopes, our aims are one
And often for each other flows
But we shall still be joined in heart,
And longs to see the day.
And sin, we shall be free,
And perfect love and friendship reign

topics: God's Children - the Faithful (see also Saints, People of the World)
